title: Pound
sourceLines: -The Hebrew word “maneh” is translated “pound,” 1Ki 10:17; Ezr 2:69; Ne 7:71,72
-And is equivalent to almost one pound (fourteen ounces)
-In John the weight was equivalent to about twelve ounces Joh 12:3
-In Luke the Greek word “mina” is translated “pound,” and worth approximately one-hundred denarii (more than three months’ wages) Lu 19:13-25
